science.headline: The method isn't guesswork
science.summary: Mind Compass is built on cognitive behavioral therapy — the same approach clinicians use for compulsive porn use — and on how the brain's reward system actually adapts.

points.detail: Compulsive sexual behavior is recognized by the World Health Organization in the ICD-11. You're dealing with something real.

points.claim: CBT is proven for compulsive behavior
points.detail: Cognitive behavioral therapy is one of the most evidence-based approaches for changing compulsive habits.
points.source: Antons et al., J. Behavioral Addictions (2022)

points.claim: Your brain adapts — and can re-adapt
points.detail: Brain-imaging studies show compulsive sexual behavior involves reward and cue-reactivity patterns similar to other addictions.

science.disclaimer: Mind Compass is a self-improvement and educational program, not a medical device or a substitute for professional care. Individual results vary.

questions.question: Is this really private?
questions.answer: Yes. Nothing about the app or your account announces what it's for, and your data is private and secure. No one sees it but you.

questions.question: What if it doesn't work for me?
questions.answer: 30 days. If it's not for you, we refund you in full — see our money-back policy for the details.

questions.question: I've tried to quit porn before and failed.
questions.answer: Everyone here has. Willpower isn't what this runs on — you get a plan for the exact moment the urge hits, so you're not relying on gritting your teeth at 1am.

questions.question: My triggers are everywhere. I can't escape them.
questions.answer: You don't have to. The goal is taking their power away, not removing them. You'll learn what to do in the ten seconds that matter.

questions.question: How is this different from a blocker app?
questions.answer: A blocker hides porn from you and you route around it by week two. This works on the pattern underneath — what sets you off, and what to do instead. You stop wanting it rather than fighting to reach it.
